display.purpose: Site name and largest identity moments. Serif-first, calm, precise.

headline.purpose: Panel headings and project-page section heads.

body.purpose: Explanatory copy with practical line lengths and generous line-height on dark fields.

label.purpose: Navigation, counters, metadata, and machine annotations only.

shadows.name: soft-ink-shadow
shadows.purpose: Large atmospheric feature surfaces such as editorial cards and page finales.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square-edged, bordered action with green state feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) 70%, transparent); padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; color: var(--fg); font: inherit; transition: transform var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), border-color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), background-color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), box-shadow var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 42%, var(--border)); background: var(--surface); color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent), 0 0 0 5px var(--bg); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; color: var(--fg); font: inherit; transition: background-color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), box-shadow var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 8%, transparent); color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent), 0 0 0 5px var(--bg); }

components.name: Side Navigation Link
components.description: Mono rail link with dot state; color alone never carries active state.
components.css: .ds-side-link { display: block; position: relative; width: fit-content; margin-left: -14px; padding-left: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-side-link::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.4); transition: opacity 180ms var(--ease-out-quart), transform 180ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-side-link:hover, .ds-side-link.is-active { color: var(--accent); } .ds-side-link.is-active::before { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1); }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Green link with a deliberate underline and seal hover.
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: var(--accent); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.24em; transition: color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), text-decoration-color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--seal); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent), 0 0 0 5px var(--bg); }

components.name: Portfolio Row
components.description: Flat rule-separated row; never a lifted card.
components.html: AI toolingShape agent workflows and eval loops.01
components.css: .ds-portfolio-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 24px; padding: 20px 0 19px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); color: var(--fg); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart), transform var(--dur-mid) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-portfolio-row strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.22; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-portfolio-row small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-portfolio-row em { color: var(--stone); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-portfolio-row:hover { color: var(--accent); transform: translateX(0.25rem); }

components.name: Quiet Chip
components.description: Compact metadata tag, not a card substitute.
components.css: .ds-quiet-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) 72%, transparent); padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: Project-page feature plane with faint paper ruling and soft ink shadow.
components.css: .ds-editorial-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) 92%, var(--bg)); box-shadow: 0 18px 56px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-ink) 70%, transparent); padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--fg); } .ds-editorial-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: repeating-linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0 34px, var(--paper-line) 35px 36px); opacity: 0.45; } .ds-editorial-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.65rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.22; } .ds-editorial-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview:
This system is a compact dark portfolio for a builder whose work spans enterprise software, AI tooling, Nix, Kubernetes, and small personal systems. The physical scene is a developer and potential customer reading the site on a large display in a dim office after hours. The page should feel discovered, precise, and lived-in, not converted from a portfolio template.

The shell may keep Mitchell Hashimoto-inspired layout mechanics: sticky rail, compact navigation, hash-target panels, and restrained footer attribution. That influence stops at structure. The identity should come from Zhongjie's copy, panda mark, project choices, serif rhythm, green signals, and the quiet particle field.
keyCharacteristics: Dark purple workshop field, not pure black.
Serif-first typography with mono labels only where metadata earns it.
CSS-driven navigation, panels, motion, and particle field.
Rows, rules, and metadata instead of generic cards.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Green marks state, links, focus, and small living details. If a section becomes green because it needs excitement, the section is wrong.

rules.name: The No Pure Extremes Rule
rules.body: Never use pure black or pure white. Every neutral stays tinted toward the purple workshop field.

rules.name: The Serif Is the Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not replace the serif stack with a generic product sans unless the brand direction changes again.

rules.name: The Mono Must Earn It Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only where it behaves like a label, counter, nav system, or machine annotation.

rules.name: The Flat Rows Rule
rules.body: Portfolio rows stay flat. Hover moves them horizontally by 0.25rem; it does not lift them into cards.

dos: Do keep Mitchell attribution as structural lineage only: layout, sticky rail, and navigation logic.
Do make new visual choices more Zhongjie-specific through copy, marks, project evidence, and small personal artifacts.
Do use rows, rules, metadata, and compact panels before reaching for cards.
Do keep motion transform-and-opacity based, using ease-out-quart, ease-out-quint, or ease-out-expo.
Do preserve the dark OKLCH workshop field and the rare green signal system.
donts: Don't make the site feel like a copied portfolio template, Chronark clone, or Mitchell homage.
Don't use a generic SaaS hero, hero-metric template, identical card grid, gradient text, decorative glass, pure black, or pure white.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders wider than 1px on cards, rows, callouts, or alerts.
Don't add client JavaScript, canvas, or new dependencies to solve homepage navigation or the particle field.
Don't use monospace as costume for technical credibility. Use it only for labels, nav, counters, and metadata.
